QuestInfo.name: [Azwan] The False Elixir 4
QuestInfo.0: The elixir circulating in Ariant was a fake containing Hilla's magic. Talk to #bMedina#k in the #bAzwan Refugee Zone#k.
QuestInfo.1: Medina says Hilla probably spread the rumor about the Elixir of Everlasting Youth, and that you should tell the Alliance about it. Talk to #bGardin#k at the #bAzwan Obelisk#k.
QuestInfo.2: Gardin said he will continue tracking the elixir and stop the spread of the false rumor. He will also send word to Areda, the queen of Ariant.

0.0: If there are rumors floating around about the elixir, I have to assume that was Hilla's doing as well. It's fortunate that this was caught early, but I have to wonder what the grander scheme was behind this.
0.1: You should inform the Alliance. They'll be needed to prevent the situation from worsening.

0.msg: As you well understand having experienced it yourself, Hilla's illusion magic is tremendously powerful. Once it takes hold, you'll gradually lose yourself.

1.msg: Remember that well in the #rmoment you face Hilla yourself#k. I have a feeling that you two will meet, and shamaness's hunch is never wrong. Please be careful.

2.msg: #b(I should tell Gardin what I just learned.)

no.0: Are you afraid? It's understandable, Hilla is a terrifying foe.

1.0: Welcome back. Any luck finding out about the elixir? ...So, it's not an #rElixir of Everlasting Youth but rather an elixir of insanity#k? Well, that changes things.
1.1: Just as Medina guessed, Hilla's probably behind the spread of the elixirs. Unfortunately, it looks like some may have already gotten out of Ariant.
1.2: We'll continue tracking them and shutting down the rumor mill. Though, there's another rumor floating about now, that #rQueen Areda is seeking the Elixir of Everlasting Youth#k... We'll send her a warning, just in case.

0.msg: #b(I should tell Gardin what I just learned.)
